components.goal: Approximate the implicit hypergradient with variation-controlled deterministic bias.

components.name: Frozen direction and lower-gradient difference
components.operation: Freeze a0 at the unperturbed lower solution, solve a linear tilt, and divide the lower x-gradient displacement by t.
components.requires: The exact mathematical operations and regularity of the ideal variant.
transfer_checks: Preserve the unperturbed upper evaluation point and frozen direction

variants.cost: Two mathematical lower minimizations, one exact f_y evaluation, one exact f_x evaluation and two exact g_x evaluations. These operation counts are not raw-SFO costs. variants.implementation_details_ref: Appendix B.1 equations (32)–(36), p.17; actual SFO realization in Algorithm 1 p.9 and Lemma B.1 pp.18–19
variants.name: Exact fixed-direction tilt component
variants.output: Deterministic vector h_t∈R^{d_x} at the supplied x, not an outer point with a stationarity guarantee.
public_inputs: Fixed x, t>0, primitive budgets μ,L_g,C_f,ρ; optional ε for bias tuning
variants.query_and_update: Compute y_t=argmin_y[g(x,y)+t<a0,y>]. Evaluate f_x(x,y0), g_x(x,y_t), g_x(x,y0) and return h_t=f_x(x,y0)+(g_x(x,y_t)−g_x(x,y0))/t. This component has no outer update.
variants.requirements: Full Euclidean lower space; global μ-strong convexity; required smoothness and ρ-Lipschitz g_yy,g_xy; ||f_y||≤C_f. Exact lower minimization and exact partial-gradient evaluation are required to evaluate this ideal variant; Definition 3.2 does not supply them free.
variants.state_and_initialization: At the supplied x define y0=argmin_y g(x,y), evaluate a0=f_y(x,y0), and freeze a0. These exact operations are mathematical requirements of this component.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Any t>0 defines the ideal component. For ε>0 and Eρ=(1+L_g/μ)ρC_f²/(2μ²), use t=1 when Eρ=0 and otherwise min{1,ε/(128Eρ)}. Both mathematical minimizations are exact; approximate stopping is a separate implementation layer.

use_restrictions: Component only; do not treat exact inner minimization as a free oracle capability.
No end-to-end stationarity or raw-SFO rate follows from this record alone.
